name: string
description: Use String apps and the web through one MCP tool. Install an app from a GitHub URL, read pages as markdown, run typed actions on documents — the whole String runtime exposed as a single `mcp__string__string` tool, with a skill that teaches Codex when and how to use it.

interface.shortDescription: Use String apps, pages, and shell sessions through one MCP tool.
interface.longDescription: String gives Codex one small command surface for installable SFMD apps, markdown pages, web pages, and shell sessions. The bundled MCP server exposes a single `string` tool with `topic` and `cmd` arguments.
defaultPrompt: Install a String app from GitHub and try it
Use String to inspect the current app sessions
